verdict.rationale: Honcho ships an official MCP server, hosted at mcp.honcho.dev or run locally, that gives any MCP-compatible AI tool persistent memory. It also offers a Claude Code plugin and a shared ~/.honcho/config.json used by host integrations. Its docs explicitly claim Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and custom agents all read the same understanding of the user. missing for 10: no evidence of ChatGPT connectivity, no independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-tool shared memory.
